title: Cultural burden — the sentence stuck in her throat (myth flip)
caption:
Myth: keeping the peace keeps everyone fine. In 1991 Dana Jack named it — self-silencing. Framingham Offspring Study, 2007: women who stayed quiet in marital fights had ~4x the death rate.
Which myth next? 👇
www.aiforheratx.org
#selfsilencing #womensmentalhealth #culturalburden #womenshealth #desiwomen

scenes.text: At the table she is the calm one, and the sentence stays stuck in her throat.
phrases: Don't start. Not in front of Mummy.
You're lucky he helps at all, no?
She's been holding one sentence since March.

scenes.text: Staying quiet was never free. Dana Jack measured it in 1991 and called it self-silencing.
phrases: She thought it was just good manners.
Turns out it has a name.

scenes.text: She says one true sentence out loud tonight, then walks twenty minutes after dinner.
phrases: Say one true sentence out loud tonight.
Not the whole speech. One sentence.
Then walk 20 minutes after dinner — WHO asks for 150 a week.
